description: This file contains server-side load function and actions for creating a new invoice in a SvelteKit application. It handles fetching initial data for the form and processing form submissions to create invoices, including handling related entities like accounts, contacts, and templates.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads necessary data for the new invoice page, including accounts, contacts, and invoice templates, handling organization validation and error cases.

methods.name: actions.create
methods.description: Handles form submission to create a new invoice, validating required fields, parsing line items, building invoice data, and making API request to persist it.

calls: apiRequest('/invoices/', { method: 'POST', body: invoiceData }, { cookies, org: locals.org })
